title: Producer claims for a research experiment report (v0.1.0, proposed)
description: Everything a producer (an agent or a script) asserts about its own experiment. The producer writes this file and the experiment program; the runtime executes the program, observes the outputs and assembles the artifact. Nothing here is evidence. The schema has no field for provenance, digests, exit status or metric values: those are never accepted from the producer.

file.description: Where the collector finds the dataset bytes to hash. workspace:<path> is a file committed in the workspace; output:<path> is a file the experiment writes; package:<import-name>/<path> is a file inside an installed Python package.

json_pointer.description: Where the value is in metrics.json. The collector reads the value; the producer never states it.

renderer.description: Name of the Python package that renders the image. Defaults to matplotlib.

outputs.description: Optional declarations for files the experiment writes. Undeclared files are still hashed; they get role other and determinism volatile, except metrics.json and figure files, which default to byte-identical.

statement.description: Prose. A number that comes from a metric is written as a slot, {{metric:<name>}} or {{metric:<name>:<decimals>}}, which the collector fills from the hashed metrics file.
